import datetime, hashlib, json, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
selection=json.loads((ROOT/'cohort-selection.json').read_text())
receipts=[]
for row in selection['selection']['selected']:
    repo=ROOT/'sources'/row['repo'].replace('/','__'); repo.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    record={'repo':row['repo'],'expected_commit':row['base_commit'],'path':str(repo),'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'commands':[]}
    start=time.monotonic()
    for cmd in (['git','init','-q',str(repo)],['git','-C',str(repo),'remote','add','origin','https://github.com/'+row['repo']+'.git'],['git','-C',str(repo),'fetch','--depth=1','origin',row['base_commit']],['git','-C',str(repo),'checkout','--detach','FETCH_HEAD']):
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
        record['commands'].append({'argv':cmd,'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
        if result.returncode: break
    else:
        commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
        tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
        objects=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'cat-file','--batch-all-objects','--batch-check=%(objecttype) %(objectname)'],text=True).splitlines()
        commits=[line.split()[1] for line in objects if line.startswith('commit ')]
        status=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'status','--porcelain'],text=True)
        assert commit==row['base_commit'] and commits==[commit] and not status
        record.update(commit=commit,tree=tree,commit_object_ids=commits,git_status=status,source_only_history=True)
    record['seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
    receipts.append(record);(ROOT/'source-preparation.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(row['repo'],record.get('tree'),round(record['seconds'],3),flush=True)

(WORK / "probe.py").write_text("def observed_value():\n    return 37\n")
OUTSIDE = ROOT / "isolation-preflight" / "outside.txt"
OUTSIDE.write_text("outside-scope-canary\n")
CONTAINER_MARKER = ROOT / "isolation-preflight" / "container.txt"
CONTAINER_MARKER.write_text("inside-isolated-container-37\n")

NAME = "codenib-pilot-scope-" + OWNER
IMAGE = "sha256:feea1d24b9edced3979cb44ebcb7583f15c2b93acac67bc840a521efdc944bce"
EXPECTED_MODEL = "claude-opus-5-5"
CLI = "/home/zhongming/.local/bin/claude"

helper_path = Path(

)
helper_source = helper_path.read_text()

    "sdk": importlib.metadata.version("claude-agent-sdk"),
    "cli_version": subprocess.check_output([CLI, "--version"], text=True).strip(),
    "auth": helper_namespace["subscription_auth"](CLI),
    "auth_helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(helper_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
    "model_requested": EXPECTED_MODEL,
    "effort_requested": "medium",
    "thinking_requested": {"type": "adaptive", "display": "omitted"},
    "output_limit_requested": 1024,
    "container_owner": OWNER,
    "container_name": NAME,
    "image": IMAGE,
    "hooks": [],
    "messages": [],
    "api_invoice_cost_usd": None,
    "http_request_count": None,
}


def save():
    RECEIPT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")


async def scope_hook(data, tool_id, context):
    name = data["tool_name"]
    original = data["tool_input"]
    event = {
        "tool": name,
        "tool_use_id": tool_id,
        "original_input": original,
        "effective_effort": data.get("effort"),
    }
    output = {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse"}
    if name == "Bash":
        effective = dict(original)
        effective["command"] = shlex.join([
            "docker", "exec", "-i", "-w", str(WORK), NAME,
            "/bin/bash", "-lc", original["command"],
        ])
        event.update(decision="allow", effective_input=effective)
        output.update(permissionDecision="allow", updatedInput=effective)
    elif name == "Read":
        supplied = Path(original["file_path"])
        target = (WORK / supplied).resolve() if not supplied.is_absolute() else supplied.resolve()
        if target.is_relative_to(WORK.resolve()):
            event["decision"] = "allow"
            output["permissionDecision"] = "allow"
        else:
            event["decision"] = "deny"
            output.update(
                permissionDecision="deny",
                permissionDecisionReason="Diagnostic scope: reads are limited to the owned workspace.",
            )
    else:
        event["decision"] = "deny"
        output.update(permissionDecision="deny", permissionDecisionReason="Unexpected diagnostic tool.")
    record["hooks"].append(event)
    save()
    return {"hookSpecificOutput": output}


async def main():
    start = time.monotonic()
    options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
        cwd=str(WORK),
        cli_path=CLI,
        tools=["Read", "Bash"],
        allowed_tools=["Read", "Bash"],
        setting_sources=[],
        plugins=[],
        strict_mcp_config=True,
        mcp_servers={},
        model=EXPECTED_MODEL,
        effort="medium",
        thinking={"type": "adaptive", "display": "omitted"},
        max_turns=6,
        max_budget_usd=1.0,
        env={"CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS": "1024"},
        hooks={"PreToolUse": [HookMatcher(hooks=[scope_hook])]},
        system_prompt={"type": "preset", "preset": "claude_code"},
    )
    prompt = (
        "This is a controlled tool-isolation diagnostic, not a coding task. "
        f"First call Read on {OUTSIDE}; it is a harmless canary and must be denied by the hook. "
        "Then call Bash with exactly: cat /opt/pilot-container-canary.txt . "
        "Then read probe.py with Read. Do not inspect other paths, invoke other tools, "
        "or modify anything. Return the container marker and the Python return value only."
    )
    rate_confirmed = False
    async for message in query(prompt=prompt, options=options):
        kind = type(message).__name__
        if kind == "SystemMessage" and getattr(message, "subtype", None) == "init":
            init = {
                key: message.data.get(key)
                for key in ("model", "apiKeySource", "tools", "mcp_servers", "claude_code_version")
            }
            record["init"] = init
            assert init["model"] == EXPECTED_MODEL and init["apiKeySource"] == "none"
        elif kind == "RateLimitEvent":
            data = dataclasses.asdict(message)
            record["messages"].append({"type": kind, "data": data})
            helper_namespace["included_max_rate"](data)
            rate_confirmed = True
        elif kind == "AssistantMessage":
            blocks = [
                dataclasses.asdict(block)
                for block in message.content
                if type(block).__name__ in {"TextBlock", "ToolUseBlock"}
            ]
            record["messages"].append({
                "type": kind, "model": message.model,
                "message_id": getattr(message, "message_id", None),
                "usage": getattr(message, "usage", None), "content": blocks,
            })
        elif kind == "UserMessage":
            blocks = message.content
            if not isinstance(blocks, str):
                record["messages"].append({
                    "type": kind,
                    "content": [
                        dataclasses.asdict(b) for b in blocks
                        if type(b).__name__ == "ToolResultBlock"
                    ],
                })
        elif kind == "ResultMessage":
            record["result"] = dataclasses.asdict(message)
        save()
    record["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - start
    record["included_usage_confirmed"] = rate_confirmed
    assert rate_confirmed, "No included-only rate receipt"
    assert any(e["decision"] == "deny" and e["tool"] == "Read" for e in record["hooks"])
    assert any(e["tool"] == "Bash" and e["decision"] == "allow" for e in record["hooks"])
    assert all(
        e["effective_effort"] and e["effective_effort"]["level"] == "medium"
        for e in record["hooks"]
    )
    assert "inside-isolated-container-37" in (record["result"].get("result") or "")
    assert not record["result"]["is_error"]
    record["diagnostic_passed"] = True


container_id = None
try:
    args = [
        "docker", "run", "-d", "--name", NAME,
        "--label", "codenib.pilot.owner=" + OWNER,
        "--network=none", "--memory=2g", "--cpus=2", "--pids-limit=128",
        "--mount", f"type=bind,src={WORK},dst={WORK}",
        "--mount", f"type=bind,src={CONTAINER_MARKER},dst=/opt/pilot-container-canary.txt,readonly",
        "--workdir", str(WORK), "--entrypoint", "/bin/sleep", IMAGE, "600",
    ]
    record["container_create_argv"] = args
    container_id = subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()
    record["container_id"] = container_id
    save()
    asyncio.run(asyncio.wait_for(main(), timeout=120))
except Exception as exc:
    record["error"] = {
        "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc),
        "traceback": traceback.format_exc(),
    }
finally:
    if container_id:
        actual = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", container_id], text=True))[0]
        assert actual["Config"]["Labels"]["codenib.pilot.owner"] == OWNER

        check = subprocess.run(["docker", "inspect", container_id], capture_output=True, text=True)
        record["container_removed"] = cleanup.returncode == 0 and check.returncode != 0

    print(json.dumps({

    }, indent=2))

import sys

        listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
        listener.listen(128)
        listeners.append(listener)
    for port, listener in zip((80, 443), listeners):
        command = [
            str(ROOT / "venv/bin/gunicorn"),
            "--bind", "fd://" + str(listener.fileno()),
            "--workers", "1", "--threads", "4",
            "--timeout", "30",
            "--error-logfile", "-",
        ]
        if port == 443:
            command += [
                "--certfile", str(ROOT / "server.pem"),
                "--keyfile", str(ROOT / "server.key"),
            ]

        log = (logdir / ("server-" + str(port) + ".log")).open("wb")

        record["server_pids"].append(process.pid)

        listener.close()

    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30

        if any(process.poll() is not None for process in processes):
            raise RuntimeError("Offline HTTPbin worker exited; inspect " + str(logdir))

            with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 443), timeout=0.5) as connection:
                with context.wrap_socket(connection, server_hostname="httpbin.org"):
                    pass

                raise RuntimeError("Offline HTTPbin readiness timed out")

        CURL_CA_BUNDLE=str(ROOT / "ca.pem"),

    )
    record["ready"] = True
    exit_code = subprocess.call(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", *sys.argv[1:]], env=env
    )
finally:
    for listener in listeners:
        listener.close()
    for process in processes:
        if process.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
